scheduler.title: Scheduling
scheduler.subtitle: Daily limits, retention, learning steps and day boundary (default deck)
scheduler.invalidLearnAhead: Learn ahead must be an integer between 0 and 60 minutes
scheduler.retentionHint: Desired retention accepts 0.5–0.99 (e.g. 0.9); higher values shorten intervals and increase review load.
scheduler.invalidLimit: Daily limits must be integers between 0 and {{max}}
scheduler.invalidRetention: Desired retention must be between {{min}} and {{max}}
scheduler.enableFuzz: Interval fuzz (spread cards learned on the same day)
scheduler.stepsHint: Separate steps with spaces using s / m / h / d units, e.g. "1m 10m"; leave empty to let FSRS choose short-term intervals.
scheduler.rolloverHint: Reviews before this hour still count toward the previous day, which suits late-night study (Anki defaults to 4).
scheduler.longStepWarning: FSRS works best when every step finishes the same day (under 1 day); long steps can make Hard longer than Good.
scheduler.invalidSteps: Invalid steps: use positive numbers with s / m / h / d units, at most 16 steps of up to 365 days each
scheduler.invalidRollover: The day boundary must be an integer between 0 and 23
scheduler.invalidMaximumInterval: Maximum interval must be an integer between 1 and {{max}} days
scheduler.invalidMaxAnswerSeconds: Maximum answer time must be an integer between 1 and 3600 seconds
scheduler.orderHint: With a large backlog, "most likely forgotten first" loses fewer cards; buried siblings (reverse cards, other cloze deletions of the same note) never appear back to back.

insights.title: Retention and memory
insights.hint: True retention counts only the first review of each card per day; anything but Again counts as recalled. Mature cards had stability of 21 days or more. If it stays below your desired retention, optimize the parameters in the scheduler settings below.
